resources.string: Cold start. No real nights yet, so these are priors from population data. The bands will narrow as your own nights arrive.
The window is open. It closes around %1$s.
Nothing is logged for today, so tonight is a guess.
Next thing is the window, around %1$s.
No new sleep data for %1$d days. Tonight is an estimate carried forward, not a measurement, so the window is wider than usual.
Daytime sleep today: %1$d min. It spends real sleep pressure, so tonight's window is pushed back by it rather than ignored.
Your internal day is longer than 24 hours. Left alone, everything slides later. This is the mechanism behind delayed sleep phase syndrome, not a lack of discipline.
The model keeps thousands of competing hypotheses about your body. Each real night reweights them. Effective count falling means the model is becoming certain.
No permission to read sleep or heart rate
Checks whether sleep, heart rate and SpO2 actually reach the app from your watch.
optional, but the app will only see 30 days without it
Sleep: %1$d sessions in the last 7 days
Sleep: no sessions yet. Expected on a fresh install \u2014 Health Connect does not backfill, so the first night appears tomorrow morning.
Sleep stages: present in %1$d of %2$d sessions
Sleep stages: absent. Deep and REM will be unavailable.
Heart rate: %1$d samples in the last 24 hours
Heart rate: no samples in the last 24 hours
Heart rate coverage: %1$d of 24 hours. Background measurement works.
Heart rate coverage: only %1$d of 24 hours. Either the link is young, or the watch only records during workouts.
Blood oxygen: %1$d records in the last 7 days
Blood oxygen: no records. Band 9 Active has no SpO2 sensor, so this is normal.
Freshness: nothing new for %1$s. Sync is probably stuck.
Local database: read and write work, %1$d nights stored
Light sensor: present, now %1$.0f lux, ceiling %2$.0f lux
Telegram: not set up. Morning questions and forecasts will not be sent.
Light sensor: absent. Light-based phase shift will not work.
Battery optimisation: disabled for this app
Battery optimisation: active. The system will kill background work.
Works, but with limitations. See the warnings above.
Blocking problems found. Data will not be collected.
Sleep gate over the next week
Android 12 and newer. Off by default: a sleep app is opened at night, so it stays dark and calm.
The bot asks two questions each morning and sends the evening forecast. Create a bot with BotFather, paste the token and your chat id, then press Start in the chat with the bot.
Token is fine, chat failed: %1$s. Open the chat with the bot and press Start.
Sent. Check the chat with your bot.
Coffee or an energy drink after 4pm today? Nothing is logged for today, and a rough yes here helps tonight's forecast more than a perfectly empty day.
Noted: something after 4pm, exact time unknown.
How did you sleep? 1 wrecked, 5 excellent.
How many mugs of coffee before this night?
I will not ask about drinks in the morning any more. The counters in the app and the chat commands still work, and Settings can switch the question back on.
Likely to fall asleep between %1$s and %2$s.
To hit your alarm, lights out by %1$s.
Not enough nights yet to predict how long you stay up past the window.
One JSON file with every night, answer and model value, written in English so a doctor or a language model can read it.
Rebuilds the model from the stored nights. Runs automatically after every sync; use this only if the numbers look wrong.
The current fit is discarded and recomputed from stored nights. Nothing is deleted, but confidence drops for a while.
Keeps ambient light sampling alive in the background.
Warns when the band stops sending data.
One tap. This is what the forecast leans on most.
Nothing is logged for today. Yes puts one drink in the middle of the day, which is closer to the truth than nothing at all.
Nothing has arrived for %1$d hours. Open Mi Fitness to sync.
Four permissions. Without them the app cannot work unattended.
Sleep and heart rate from your band.
Required for the light sensor and for stale data warnings.
Turn it off, otherwise the hourly sync gets killed.
On realme and ColorOS this has to be enabled by hand in system settings.
Only to read the name your band was paired under. Nothing is scanned and nothing is connected to. Without it the last screen can only say the maker.
Vespian learns when your body clock opens the door to sleep, and tells you before the evening starts. It predicts. It never tells you when to go to bed.
Sleep and heart rate arrive from your band through Health Connect. Nothing to tap. This is the accurate one.
No band needed. You mark when you fell asleep and when you woke up, two taps a day. Without heart rate the forecast window stays wider and the model needs longer to learn your clock.
You can switch mode later in Settings. Nothing is lost.
Two permissions. The chat needs them even without a band.
Health Connect is not on this phone. It is the bridge from your band, so install it and come back.
Health Connect is out of date. Update it and come back.
Connected: %1$s. Sleep and heart rate will arrive on their own.
Health Connect is empty so far. That is normal on a fresh install. Open Mi Fitness once and sync, the first night will appear by itself.
Manual mode. No band is read. You mark sleep and wake up yourself, in the app or in the chat.
Vespian bot is running. Choose the chat language.

Commands:
/help - this text
/lang - chat language
/mode - hands free or manual
/forecast - sleep window right now
/status - is data still arriving

Hands free mode: sleep comes from the band, bedtime from the moment the screen goes dark, coffee from one question in the morning. Nothing to tap.

Manual mode: adds buttons for going to bed, getting up and one more mug. Made for people without a band, or for a night when the automatic guess is wrong.
Not a command I know. The buttons below always work, and /help lists everything.
How long did it take to fall asleep, in minutes?
No bedtime tapped, so the last screen off was used: %1$s.
Background service: silent. Check battery settings.
No forecast yet. It appears once the first data arrives.
Sleep debt: about %1$d min left to repay. /corr for the plan
No bedtime marked, or it was too recent.
The band already recorded this night, keeping its numbers.
Coffee erased. Today counts as unanswered and the model was refitted without it.
Nothing to erase: no coffee recorded today.
Hands free reads everything by itself. Manual adds chat buttons for going to bed, getting up and coffee, for use without a band.
About %1$d min of pressure was left unspent when the last night ended.
Nothing worth repaying. The last night ended on its own.
Welcome, mode and the permissions checklist. Opening them again changes nothing in your data.
Percentages are shares of time asleep, the same way the band counts them.
Deep %1$d m, REM %2$d m, awake %3$d m
Vespian was stopped by the system
Background work was frozen for %1$d minutes, so Telegram replies were late. Allow auto launch and background activity for Vespian in the system battery settings.
The time you need to be awake by. The reverse alarm counts backwards from it and tells you the latest moment to switch the lights off. Leave empty if you have no fixed wake-up.
Use the 24 hour form, for example 07:30.
Caffeine in one of your mugs. The model uses it to push the predicted sleep gate later. Instant is about 130 mg, brewed about 190.
Not running. Last sign of life %1$s ago.
Last time the system froze it: %1$s.
The system has never frozen it.
Recorded around %1$s, give or take %2$d min. Spread over that window instead of pinned to a minute it probably was not.
One tap. A rough yes is worth more than an empty day.
Usually the first one lands around %1$s.
A guess from %1$d days of your own log, not a measurement. One tap fixes it.
Works without the internet. The bot asks the same questions.
What the forecast is built on
Send all data as a file

/why - what the forecast is built on
/last - what the band measured last night
/export - all your data as one file
/wakeup - the last morning was ended by an alarm or by someone else
/corr - sleep debt and a short plan
Sleep gate opens around %1$s. Asleep around %2$s.
Falling asleep takes you about %1$d min.
Your internal day runs %1$d min longer than 24 hours, so everything slides later.
Caffeine still in you: about %1$d mg. It pushes the gate later.
No caffeine left in you right now.
The window is narrow: %1$d nights agree with each other.
The window is still wide. %1$d nights recorded, it keeps narrowing.
Very little data yet, %1$d nights. Treat this as a rough guess.
Built on %1$d nights where the sleep gate was really measured and %2$d nights where you fell asleep at once, which only say the gate was already open.
Pulse low used as a body clock anchor on %1$d nights. It ignores what you chose to do.
Behaviour layer: this evening looks like about %1$d min past the open gate, learned from %2$d nights. It only decides how much tonight is allowed to say about your clock. It never moves the window.
Behaviour layer: silent, %1$d nights of %2$d. Below that it fits noise and predicts worse than your own average.
Light was read as a clock shift over %1$d stretches. Evening light pushes the clock later about eight times harder than morning light pulls it earlier.
Could not send the file. Try again in a minute.
Nights, answers, light and model state. %1$d KB. Keep this message as your backup.
Marked: you were woken up. That night now counts as at least this long, not exactly this long.
Undone. That night counts as a free wake up again.
Mark that you were woken up
The night was ended by an alarm or by someone else, not by your body.
Sleep debt and how to repay it
Not enough nights yet to put a number on debt.
No debt: the last night discharged in full.
Debt: about %1$d min of sleep not paid back.
The estimate is still rough, there are few nights.
Day %1$d: window %2$s - %3$s, about %4$d min of extra sleep.
Dim the light about two hours before the window. Bright light right after waking up.
No alarm, no fixed length. The window is where sleep comes on its own.
How many cans of energy drink before this night?
How many drinks before this night?
The bot asks about drinks only when that day has nothing logged. Anything tapped during the day is never asked about again.
Ask about drinks in the morning
One more can of energy drink
That drink is switched off. Turn it on in Settings.
One tap is one drink: half a beer, a glass of wine, a shot. No volumes needed.
Off by default. Each one adds a single tap counter, never a number to type. Caffeine strength and how fast it clears are learned from your nights, not assumed.
Counted in drinks, not millilitres. Alcohol is not treated as caffeine: it shortens the wait for sleep and takes part of the night\'s recovery away.
How well this has been working
Nothing has been graded yet, so this percentage is still the model’s own opinion of itself. Tonight’s window is saved and checked against your actual sleep tomorrow.
Provisional: only %1$d nights have been graded, and it takes about %2$d before the percentage is mostly measurement rather than assumption.
Sleep landed outside the window more often than promised, so the window has been widened until it stops overstating itself.
Sleep landed inside the window more often than promised, so the window has been narrowed to say something more useful.
The width of the window matches how often it has actually been right.

A published window is a promise to contain the night about %1$d%% of the time. This card is the app marking its own homework: the percentage above is what the record says, not what the model would like to believe.
No measured nights yet. The chart fills in as nights arrive.
%1$d nights measured. None of them had a saved forecast yet, so nothing is scored. Grading starts with tonight.
Bar is the window the model published that evening, dot is when you actually fell asleep. Nights without a bar were recorded before the app started saving its forecasts.
No light samples yet. The sampler writes one reading every five minutes while the service runs.
Bar height is how much that hour could move your clock, not raw lux. Light saturates: 300 lux is already half the effect of 3000.
No heart rate readings for this period. They arrive with each Health Connect sync.
Every point is an average over a slice of the period, so a long range is smoother rather than noisier. The shaded band is the lowest to highest reading inside each slice.
Tonight\'s sleep window at a glance.
A complete copy of everything: nights, answers, pulse, light, the model itself and every setting. Keep it outside the phone. A factory reset or a new phone costs you a month of learning otherwise.
Restored: %1$d nights, %2$d answers, %3$d readings. The model was refitted.
That file is not a vespian backup
Restoring merges: a night already recorded here is kept, and nothing is deleted. The bot token is not in the file.
